title: BluForge Pulse: Continuous Threat Intelligence & Monitoring | Quadra
description: BluForge Pulse delivers continuous threat intelligence and real-time security monitoring, giving enterprises proactive visibility into emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and attack surface exposure.

blocks.text: BluForge Pulse™ is our hybrid, co-managed MXDR service. We partner with your existing security team, augmenting their capabilities with our advanced threat hunting expertise, automation, and shared incident response
Your Team is Great. But They Can't Be Everywhere at Once

Even the best internal security teams are stretched thin. They are often bogged down in alert triage and lack the dedicated time for proactive, deep-dive threat hunting. How do you elevate your team's capabilities from reactive to proactive?

blocks.alt: a group of people holding hands in a circle

blocks.text: Our co-managed model is a true partnership. We provide the platform and the specialized expertise to supercharge your team
We provide your team with access to our unified platform, which ingests telemetry from your Microsoft and third-party sources (firewalls, other clouds) into a single incident view.
Our threat hunters, aligned with the MITRE ATT&CK framework, proactively search for hidden threats in your environment, offloading this critical task from your team.
We work together on incident response through a secure portal, with our team handling initial triage and escalation, allowing your experts to focus on the most critical events.
Secure Collaboration Portal for Shared Incident Response
